kite_map.doc: The Kite's world map (KiteMapMenu, M3-UI-205; SPEC 6.6). Rects x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3, centred. Left: the places (rows, max_rows before it scrolls: every Act I and II place, Search and Leave fit; Search and Leave last) and the line about the highlighted row (desc). Right: the chart (KiteChart): the grid's cell lines grid_px wide at grid_alpha (2 px so none is lost when the screen is scaled down), each column letter centred over its column label_pad above the grid and each row number centred on its row row_label_px left of it, region names, a gem_px gem on each place's own point, the cursor ring ring_gap_px outside the gem with the place's name name_gap_px right of the ring, and the searched cell outlined, both cursor_px wide.
